name: Summon Flying Mount, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level antipaladin 3, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 3, bard 3, cleric/oracle/warpriest 3, druid 3, hunter 3, paladin 3, ranger 3, shaman 3, skald 3, summoner 3, summoner (unchained) 3, warpriest 3, witch 3

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, DF

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect one summoned creature

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

This spell functions like summon monster III, except it allows you to summon a single pegasus, one giant eagle, one half-celestial unicorn, 1d3 hippogriffs, or 1d4+1 giant swans (see below).
